verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is a web-crawling/extraction library that exposes itself as an MCP server so other AI agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) can call its crawling tools — this is the server-provider role, not a client that consumes external MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence Crawl4AI itself ingests or plugs in third-party MCP servers to extend its own capabilities, so this axis (being an MCP client) does not apply to this kind of tool.
